mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, #{dateFormat}) AS period, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions, SUM(duration) AS total_duration, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count FROM focus_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, #{dateFormat}) AS period, COUNT(*) AS total_days, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(sleep_score) AS avg_score, AVG(deep_sleep_minutes) AS avg_deep_sleep, AVG(light_sleep_minutes) AS avg_light_sleep, AVG(rem_sleep_minutes) AS avg_rem_sleep FROM sleep_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period ASC

SELECT mode, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(duration) AS total_duration FROM focus_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND mode IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mode

SELECT CASE WHEN sleep_score >= 90 THEN 'excellent' WHEN sleep_score >= 75 THEN 'good' WHEN sleep_score >= 60 THEN 'fair' ELSE 'poor' END AS level, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sleep_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND sleep_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY level
